features.title: Independent inference
features.acceptance: Resolve a conclusion by joining independent clues; copying a single sentence cannot satisfy the advanced proof.

features.title: Distinct quest identities
features.acceptance: Each new case names and plays a distinct signature activity, central question and emotional turn.

features.title: Private theories without suspicion
features.acceptance: Saving, editing or clearing an actor's private draft changes no public revision, attempts, suspicion or NPC knowledge.

features.title: Multiple sufficient proof chains
features.acceptance: The proof verifier accepts at least two authored sufficient evidence sets and rejects unsupported or unknown evidence.

features.title: Early sufficient resolutions
features.acceptance: A player can finish once a sufficient proof is collected without visiting every optional lead.

features.title: Explicit world assumptions
features.acceptance: Players can inspect the case's applicable clocks, suspect scope and world rules before reasoning.

features.title: Precise logic language
features.acceptance: Authored quantifiers, conditions, negation and uncertainty survive projection and clause views.

features.title: Earned absence evidence
features.acceptance: An absent expected record is usable evidence only with an authored established expectation and a checked source.

features.title: Diagnostic reasoning feedback
features.acceptance: Wrong reasoning receives public-premise feedback without identifying secret correct items.

features.title: Trustworthy narration
features.acceptance: Direct narration is factual; uncertain or unreliable statements are visibly attributed.

features.title: Challenge the commission
features.acceptance: A playable alternative challenges the employer's premise and reaches a substantive resolution.

features.title: Player motives without morality scores
features.acceptance: Players can choose their own motive without hidden morality or currency effects.

features.title: Sincere mistaken witnesses
features.acceptance: A witness can sincerely believe a false claim with an evidence-backed limitation and a playable correction.

features.title: Dependable antagonist principles
features.acceptance: An antagonist follows an observable authored principle across decisions.

features.title: Distinct NPC voices
features.acceptance: Authored NPC dialogue has distinct diction and perspective in actual scenes.

features.title: Fair foreshadowing
features.acceptance: Decisive facts have reachable foreshadowing before the resolution; the reveal introduces no required new evidence.

features.title: Red herring closure
features.acceptance: An investigated red herring receives a reachable explanation or closure.

features.title: Honest disagreement endings
features.acceptance: A reasoned disagreement is a completed outcome with retained consequences.

features.title: Human scale behind conspiracies
features.acceptance: A playable investigation resolves an apparent conspiracy into a specific human problem.

features.title: Agency within a fixed outcome
features.acceptance: The case states a fixed external outcome and gives consequential choices over what remains controllable.

features.title: Known culprit and legitimate dependants
features.acceptance: A known culprit case makes protecting legitimate dependants an actionable planning problem.

features.title: Systemic mysteries without villains
features.acceptance: A systemic failure case repairs handoffs and tests the repair without inventing a villain.

features.title: Fictional truce clause edge cases
features.acceptance: A fictional agreement can be tested against clauses and authored boundary cases.

features.title: A contained legitimate work shift
features.acceptance: A contained legitimate shift contains playable work decisions, interruptions and an end state.

features.title: Bounded delegated fieldwork
features.acceptance: Players assign a bounded question and method, receive the authored report, and review the evidence.

features.title: Fictional obligations network
features.acceptance: A fictional favor/guarantee network can be inspected and resolved without real monetary effects.

features.title: Translate institutional meanings
features.acceptance: A case translates different institutional uses of the same terms using contrasting examples.

features.title: Explicit information routing
features.acceptance: Players preview recipients and explicitly route only evidence they know; NPC knowledge changes accordingly.

features.title: Dramatic irony
features.acceptance: A case distinguishes player knowledge from character knowledge and offers sensible interventions.

features.title: Open lead order
features.acceptance: Independent leads can be visited in either order while essential proof remains reachable.

features.title: Search revealed questions
features.acceptance: Search indexes only revealed questions in the actor's own case.

features.title: Mastery procedure shortcuts
features.acceptance: A repeat procedure can be skipped after demonstrated mastery while new deduction remains required.

features.title: Reentry recap and current question
features.acceptance: Returning players see revealed facts, the current open question and a concise factual recap.

features.title: Side by side evidence workbench
features.acceptance: Players can pin and compare revealed evidence without automatic answer selection.

features.title: Intent previews and precommit undo
features.acceptance: Consequential actions show an intent preview; uncommitted drafts can be changed or cleared.

features.title: Faithful clause by clause view
features.acceptance: Clause views preserve the exact authored conditions, negation and uncertainty.

features.title: Private cooperative first impressions
features.acceptance: Each participant can privately record an impression or uncertainty and choose whether to share it.

features.title: Delegated decisions and participant acknowledgement
features.acceptance: A current member can propose a permitted scene delegate; affected participants acknowledge before commitment and can safely leave.

features.title: Role spotlight without rigid turn locks
features.acceptance: Participants receive meaningful spotlight opportunities and can delegate without overriding original role gates.

features.title: Individual debrief reveal
features.acceptance: Each player opens the verdict/debrief individually; other participants can finish independently without leaking the unopened verdict.

features.title: NPC knowledge and belief ledger
features.acceptance: Authors declare what each NPC knows, believes, conceals and can learn; impossible knowledge and unjustified disclosures fail validation.

features.title: Narrative promises and payoffs
features.acceptance: Author tooling links narrative promises to reachable payoffs and reports unresolved promises.

features.title: Fact change impact preview
features.acceptance: Changing a fact previews dependent clues, dialogue, proofs and other references.

features.title: Branch budgets and meaningful reconvergence
features.acceptance: Author tooling reports branch costs and reconvergence while preserving authored consequences.

features.title: Immediate author preview presets
features.acceptance: Authors preview scenes immediately with prior-state presets using the same validation and projection rules.

features.title: Blind comprehension study
features.acceptance: An opted-in tester can submit what happened, why and what to do next; reports label evidence type and preserve raw responses.

features.title: Adversarial motivation playtests
features.acceptance: Authored tests exercise protecting a suspect, distrusting the employer and competing loyalties through real runtime paths.

features.title: Semantic spoiler audit
features.acceptance: Author tooling flags spoiler-bearing titles, rewards, markers and errors before publication.

features.title: Pacing by activity type
features.acceptance: Author tooling measures reading, reasoning, repetition and travel; reports chores separately from quiet or comic beats.

features.title: Opt in delayed recall study
features.acceptance: An opted-in tester can submit enjoyment, understanding and unaided recall only after at least 24 hours of server time; results are not fabricated.
